title: Секрет паштета  (The Secret of the Pâté)

segments.t: Back in the kitchen, the Chef finally shows Maks the real, unglamorous ingredients of the famous beef pâté, and Maks is completely shocked by what he sees. Let's listen closely to the conversation in Russian first, and then walk through each line together.
